articles.detail: 5 cycles, 4 completed at audit time, avg 10 published/cycle — down from yesterday's 59 with the 22:00 cycle still in flight

experiment: Skipped, and the gate is now down. No experiment was active to evaluate; the noNewExperimentsUntil field (2026-07-28) reached its date and was dropped from content/.experiments.json rather than extended, as the migration note specified. Nothing is proposed today because every goal metric cleared its target with margin — the rule is skip-if-healthy, and a variable introduced against a clean day measures noise.
weakestArea: Region distribution, inside a metric that passes. The Americas took 18 of 50 (36%, up from 31%) while Europe fell 10 → 6 and Oceania held at 1 for the fourth consecutive day. The regions target counts presence, not balance, so a run this AM-heavy still scores 6/6. Behind it sits yesterday's measurement caveat unchanged: freshness is computed over 10 of 50 articles — the rest carry no resolvable upstream timestamp — so a median of 0.1 rests on a 20% sample.
watching: Ukrainian air defence became a supply story rather than a battlefield one: two separate filings on Patriot interceptor output trailing the drone barrage rate, alongside Zelenskyy's Washington ask.
Sudan recaptured the Bara junction, carried by Radio Dabanga alone — a single-outlet thread on the cycle's most consequential African military move.
Gaza forced cashless under siege — the blockade's second-order financial effect, with a natural follow-up in remittance and banking data.
Aramco shutting the Jazan refinery, worth reading against the Gulf infrastructure stress tracked yesterday at Bandar Abbas.
Two 2026-08-12 total-eclipse articles are already filed ahead of the event; check they do not surface as near-duplicates when the rolling window reaches them.
Kashmir protesters branded khawarij — takfiri language entering state security framing is a thread the site is unusually placed to follow.
Russia accelerating digital-asset rules in the same cycle as CoinDesk's three filings — regulatory and market tracks converging.
coverageGaps: Oceania produced 1 story of 50 for the fourth consecutive day; still no curated source based there.
Europe fell 10 → 6 with nothing from Southern or Central Europe — DW, RTE and Ukrainska Pravda carried the continent between them.
Latin America is again invisible inside the AM bucket, which reads as US coverage; InSight Crime appeared yesterday and not today.

Science leaned on generalists (BBC, CBS News, The Times of India, Haberler.com) beside Nature, Phys.org, Carbon Brief and SciDev.Net — a thinner specialist share than yesterday's Quanta/New Scientist/STAT run.
Central Asia and the Caucasus remain absent apart from a single APA filing — the second day with effectively no dateline between Ankara and Delhi.
context: First day past the Opus 5 re-baseline window, and the post-migration numbers hold: multi-source at 9 against a floor of 4 — the highest reading in the file and up from 7 — with 48 unique sources, top-source share at 8%, zero duplicates, freshness median 0.1 days and sci-tech at 46%. Category counts flattened usefully too: politics 15 against tech 12, economy 12, science 11, with every floor cleared by wide margins, so the selector floors are not the binding constraint on mix. State media accounted for 5 of 50 (TASS 2, RT, Mehr, Anadolu), inside the source policy as position-carrying rather than substitute reporting, and the isnad ranking withholds their proximity promotion automatically. Yesterday's guidance on the first post-gate candidate stands and is unchanged by today: it should be feed-side rather than selector-side, since the 2026-05-16 evaluation established the selector's multi-source floor is exhausted and the constraint is upstream supply. TOP_EVENTS_TO_FETCH stays at 8 — each unit is one NewsAPI token per cycle against a capped spend.
